messages.author: 33fe3608622d7c76
messages.subject: Error in lapply(obj, function(val) { : object 'zipdata' not found
parts:
Hello,

I am having trouble deploying my Shiny App (even though its working as runApp()) and haven't been able to find the answer to my question online. My application successfully deploys, but I get an error message in the url that reads: ERROR: object 'zipdata' not found.

My zipdata file is being read in as:
global.r
allzips <- readRDS("data/superzip.rds")

server.r (before shinyServer())
zipdata <- allzips[sample.int(nrow(allzips), 1000),]

Any help would be greatly appreciated. 

Thanks,
Sarah

Best,
Sarah
